title: W5500 Ethernet with TI C2000
description: Integrating a W5500 Ethernet controller with the TMS320F28375D using SPI-B, FIFO and DMA-based transfers, with Modbus TCP communication as an application target.
details: Register-level SPI-B driver approach with manual chip select.
DMA transmit/receive path and FIFO behavior investigation.
Socket lifecycle, network initialization and packet-level troubleshooting.
Wireshark-based inspection of Ethernet and Modbus TCP traffic.

title: Linux Mini Shell
description: A C-based shell project focused on command interpretation, process creation, built-in commands and job control.
details: Command parsing and execution flow.
Process creation and program replacement using fork/exec concepts.
Built-in command handling and process management.
Signal handling and job-control learning.

title: Industrial IoT Gateway
description: A multi-node system concept connecting sensor and peripheral nodes to an ESP32 gateway for protocol bridging and telemetry.
details: STM32 node concept for environmental sensing and local display.
RP2040 node concept for RFID, servo and ultrasonic interfaces.
ESP32 gateway concept for wired/wireless connectivity and MQTT.
Architecture concept; update implementation status as modules are completed.

title: W55RP20 Protocol Platform
description: Evaluating an Ethernet-enabled MCU platform for industrial communication, including EtherNet/IP adapter architecture and firmware-update requirements.
details: WIZnet-PICO-C SDK and board support setup.
EtherNet/IP adapter feasibility and stack integration planning.
Explicit messaging and Class 1 I/O architecture research.
Safe maintenance state and OTA workflow considerations.

title: MicroShell on RP2040
description: A lightweight command-line interface built with the Raspberry Pi Pico SDK, exploring command interaction and peripheral-control extensions.
details: Build and flash workflow using Pico SDK.
USB stdio initialization and terminal interaction.
Potential extension to I²C OLED status and command output.

title: DHCP with W5500
description: Studying DHCP packet construction and network configuration over W5500, including how a device obtains network parameters.
details: DHCP Discover, Offer, Request and Acknowledge exchange.
IP address, subnet mask, gateway, DNS and lease information.
Packet layout and W5500 socket/register-level handling.
